description: Converting to a map of lists of any is an error when the converted lists have no common type
notes: Not disputed like native/functions/function-error-is-eval-error: the README defines convert's result as the conversion, and the spec makes this conversion an error, because the converted lists, a list of numbers and a list of tuples, have no common type (spec.md#type-unification).
reference_error: cannot find a common base type for all elements
